Expedite permissions for telecom towers and fibre rollout to widen rural digital services, banking, insurance and courier access.
Equip remote-village service points with reliable internet so citizens can actually use MeeSeva and digital-governance infrastructure.

Scale SHG-led food-processing enterprises through targeted credit linkage beyond the 32 currently loan-backed groups, backed by bank-linked field staff.
Strengthen SHG-bank linkages, crop insurance and digital payments, running loan camps for KCC, Mudra and SVANidhi in underserved pockets.
Extend basic banking, insurance and courier access to rural areas that still lack them, using bank mitras and digital kiosks.

interventions: Accelerate PMAY housing while closing the external infrastructure gap, since housing progress remains insufficient for growing demand and youth outmigration.
Develop the NH-67-linked warehousing and logistics hub to convert land into productive rental and commercial real-estate activity.
Digitise property registration and mutation at district registrars and strengthen RERA implementation to widen the tax base and speed disputes.
Scale Gokulam Sheds and rural commercial space for CSCs, BPOs and e-commerce warehousing to expand the built-asset base beyond housing.
real_estate.grounding: WOOP doc + toolkit: grounds on the housing-demand gap and youth outmigration, NH-67 warehousing, Gokulam Sheds and RERA/registration digitisation.

Replicate the One Month One Constituency Four Villages model to concentrate revenue and grievance-resolution effort at village level.
Fill vacant field positions through timely recruitment and adopt digital systems to raise operational efficiency in service delivery.

Extend telemedicine, mobile libraries and modernised Anganwadi centres to bridge the rural-urban education and healthcare access gap.
Position the district as a rural banking, e-governance and knowledge-services hub by upgrading school infrastructure and technology-based skilling.
